messages.subject: Constrain Item Intercepts
parts:
Hi everyone,

Thanks in advance for your help on this one. I am running a time invariance analysis and would like to constrain my item intercepts to equality across two time points. I know I can use the .groups.equal function to do this, but I would also like to know how to do this within the model syntax itself.

-Adam

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Constrain Item Intercepts
parts: how to do this within the model syntax itself.

If you give parameters the same label, they will be constrained to equality.  See the section "Simple equality constraints"

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Constrain Item Intercepts
parts: I have read through this (and other pages on the website) and still cannot manage to equate two item intercepts to equal each other. Could you provide any more guidance on doing this?

Providing your own script would allow us to use your own example to show you how it is done.  I saw you did this on SEMNET, where Ed answered, which I will post here for anyone else who might read this:

Item1 ~ constraint*1
Item2 ~ constraint*1

where "constraint" is an arbitrary label (it could just as well be "tau1"), but any parameters with that label will have the same value.  Labels (or any modifier, such as a fixed value or starting value) always goes on the right-hand side of the equation, not the left.

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html
